fusions.name: Polyp Fan
fusions.desc: Opens a fan of stinging threads in a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Spawning Burst
fusions.desc: Lobs an egg sac that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Air Bell
fusions.desc: Spins a bell of air where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Calcified Lattice
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
